title: Sheep Efficiency
description: Sheep Efficiency is a Minecraft mod that prevents woolly sheep from eating grass, only sheared adults are allowed to graze, so your wool supply stays efficient without micromanaging.
body:
# Sheep Efficiency

**Sheep Efficiency** keeps your wool farm running smoothly by preventing sheep from eating grass when they don't need to.

In vanilla Minecraft, all sheep, including woolly ones, constantly graze and turn grass blocks to dirt. This mod changes that: only sheared sheep will eat grass to regrow their wool. Woolly adults and baby sheep leave the grass alone entirely.

This means your pastures stay green, your farm looks better, and you stop fighting a losing battle against mud patches. No configuration needed, install and forget.

## Features

- 🐑 Woolly sheep (unsheared adults) never eat grass
- 🍼 Baby sheep never eat grass
- ✂️ Sheared sheep graze normally to regrow wool
- ⚙️ Zero configuration, zero performance impact
- 🌐 Works in singleplayer and multiplayer
